meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页和界面的显示效果，输出截图与结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常调整界面，想快速确认外观没有变坏。
copy.tagline_en: Inspect web, terminal, or paginated UI and get a screenshot-based verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you update UIs often and want to double-check appearances before sharing.

howto.what: 要校验界面是否合格时,它会为网页、终端界面或分页文档的每一页截图留证,再让两组只看不改的独立复核同时核对设计与画面细节,最后给出一个“通过 / 需修改 / 失败”的结论。
howto.when: 刚搭建或改动界面之后,或你问某个页面、组件或终端界面看起来对不对时,会触发。纯逻辑、没有画面输出的任务不触发。

say.text: 我刚改完登录页的样式,帮我做一轮视觉质检。
say.note: 它先截图并用两组复核,再给结论。

say.text: 这个终端界面排版对吗?帮忙检查有没有边框错位或文字截断。
say.note: 会跑终端专用的宽度与边框检查。

say.text: 把这份 PDF 报告逐页过一遍,确认没有排版问题。
say.note: 每页会渲染成图片来核对,不只看文字。

howto.what_en: For a UI review, Claude screenshots every page of web, terminal, or paginated surfaces, runs two parallel read-only reviewers (design-system integrity; visual & CJK details), and issues a PASS / REVISE / FAIL verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after building or changing any rendered UI, or when asked whether a page, component, or terminal UI looks right. Pure logic with no visual output does not trigger it.

say_en.text: I just changed the login styles - run a visual QA.
say_en.note: Screenshots are taken and two reviewers return a verdict.

say_en.text: Does this terminal UI look right? Check borders and clipped text.
say_en.note: Runs width/border checks plus a visual pass.

say_en.text: Inspect every page of this PDF report for layout issues.
say_en.note: Renders each page as an image for layout review.
